family_reports.body: Was never told what allegations were,was drug into court and threatened by my own attorney to give up the children. No paperwork was ever provided until a week after being taken into court. My 18 month old granddaughter nearly died from a broken heart and my 4 year old granddaughter nearly drowned at her foster house from not being watched. She saved herself because we had taught her Early on about swimming and drowning and what to do.
